MANCHESTER (12 May)—Brinfield, an online shoe retailer headquartered here, is preparing an online workshop on the advantages of using an outside quality inspector. The workshop, titled "Better Products Through Expert Partnerships," will take place on 3 June.
"Earlier this year, we had a problem with one of our best-selling running shoes," said Brinfield's operations director, Kenji Mori. "Customers ordered their usual size, but the shoes turned out to be narrower than the pairs they had bought before, so naturally they were unhappy. Thousands of pairs came back to us—simply because our size specifications were not precise enough."
Because Brinfield's shoes are produced at factories in four countries, the company could not send its own staff to every plant often enough to oversee production. It therefore hired an independent inspection firm to write detailed quality standards and to check products at each factory before shipment.
"Bringing in an outside inspector was the smartest move we have ever made," said Mr. Mori. "We hope this workshop helps other retailers avoid the mistakes we made."
To sign up for the £15 workshop or to see Brinfield's other workshops on logistics and supplier management, go to www.brinfield.co.uk/workshops. Every workshop is recorded and stored online so that registered participants can watch it whenever they like.

해석: Lumora 고객들이 불만스러워한 원인은?

options: It has manufacturing sites in more than one country.
It recently hired a new chief executive.
It replaced the sheets at no cost.

유형: PART 7 · 사실 확인
정답 (A) It has manufacturing sites in more than one country.
정답 근거: 정답 포인트 — 지문 "Lumora's products are made at plants in three countries" → 보기 "has manufacturing sites in more than one country". 3개국 공장 = 여러 나라에 제조 시설.
오답 분석: (B) only bedding: '침구만 판매'. 생활용품(home-goods) 소매업체다. 시트는 한 제품일 뿐이다. / (C) new chief executive: '새 CEO 채용'. 고용한 것은 검사 업체다. 지문 단어 hire만 노린 함정. / (D) replaced the sheets at no cost: '무료 교환'. 반품됐다(sent back)는 말만 있고 무료 교환 언급은 없다.

It is one of a number of seminars Lumora offers.
It will be available for only one week.
